My current favorite is the Rose V2-S. At its widest it's 2mm, and has completely variable airflow. Everything on it is designed to condense and improve flavor. Its juice flow control is pretty awesome, as well.

You come to in the middle of a cornfield. It's dark. You're drunk. You don't remember how you got there. You pull out your cell phone and realize it only has 2% battery remaining. It is 4AM and there are no signs of city lights or even street lamps anywhere. What do you do?
[WP] Lost in the middle of nowhere.

You wake up woozy and with a metallic taste in your mouth. Your eyes focus and you find that you're surrounded by... Grass? No, these tall figures swaying above you remind you of something that happened earlier, but everything's so fuzzy right now.

Perception. Perception is always what gets you out of these situations, as you already well know. Though, it really isn't much of a chore to take in that night's sky... You exhale slowly and alcohol fills your senses, but it's not like you've experienced before. It's... kind of reminding you of the doctor's office. That whiteness for some reason feels unpleasant though; you let your head push that thought away.

You kind of don't want to move. It feels really pleasant here. Nice and cool... really unexpected considering it's July. July... wait weren't you supposed to buy that ring soon? "Fuck De Beers" you find yourself saying out loud. What?

Everything is uncovered in your head again, unfortunately. You find yourself wishing you had a few more moments to be a non-person. You tap your pocket. Your phone is still there. Everything's kind of wet and sticky for some reason. Whatever. Let's just get this phone out.

4:12 AM

"You should consider plugging in your phone c[2%] "

your phone displays through a sticky red filter. "Fuck off phone don't tell me what to do" your instinct says. Your eyes are politely pointing to the redness that covers your entire torso. Oh. You're bleeding. That explains that pain in your side you didn't notice until now.

You sit up now. owwwwww... Okay, that was expected. You unbutton your dress-shirt and find blood peacefully bubbling out of a crudely stitched wound. You reach in your other pocket and pull out some gauze. When did you get gauze? Alright, we can ask more questions when we decide to walk...somewhere; but first you apply the gauze and tape it to your skin. You button your shirt back up and feel something lumpy in your shirt pocket.

You pull out a square black box. There's a ring in it. A really nice ring. For some reason though, it makes you sad. You remember what happened, but you decide to wait until you're moving to process that situation.

Okay! On your feet! Let's go! Your head responds by looking up at the sky and enjoying the stars. You never get to see stars, especially like these. You begrudgingly decide that not dying is more important, and you push yourself up.

You fall down. Ugh, now you're going to have to go through that whole process again. When you get back on your feet, you see now that you're in a cornfield. To your left you see that a bunch of corn has been pushed over for about as far as you can see. It's dark, you realize. You decide you'll be okay. Your feet are working, your emergency jerky is still in your whitie-tighties, and you remember that there's a street somewhere. Maybe you can call a friend to come get you. You check your phone again. You've received a text

"We're going to find you, you fucking coward"

"Shutting Down"

It'll all work out.

You pull out some safety scissors and walk towards the part of the cornfield that just ignited in a ball of flames.
